senses.gloss: (b. h. שׂוּחַ) [to think,] to talk; to tell.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:3">Shebu. VII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Shevuot 7:6">6</cite> <he>איני יודע מה אתה סָח</he> (Y. ed. <he>שָׂח</he>) I do not know what you are talking about.

<cite ref="Sotah 44b:4">Sot. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>שח בין תפילה וכ׳</he> if one talks between putting on the T’fillin of the arm and of the head; <cite ref="Menachot 36a:4">Men. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>סח</he>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Chullin 27a">Ḥull. 27ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00582"><he>חָטָא</he> I</cite>.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 755">Yalk. Ps. 755</cite>, read: <he>שָׁח</he>, v. <cite ref="U00362"><he>שׁוּחַ</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Berakhot 51b:8">Ber. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מְסִיחִין על כוס וכ׳</he> you must not converse while holding up the cup of benediction.

<cite ref="Shabbat 13b:1">Sabb. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>והיתה מְסִיחָה וכ׳</he> and she told (me) all that happened to her. Y. Gitt. IX, end, 50ᵈ <he>מסיחין</he>, <cite ref="M01318"><he>מש׳</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="O00600"><he>סִיחָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 31:1">Pesik. R. s. 31</cite> <he>עומד ומֵסִיחַ וכ׳</he> (the text, <cite ref="Isaiah 49:8">Is. XLIX, 8</cite> sq.) stands and speaks (is a standing prophecy) of the king Messiah.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 1:15">Deut. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מי אתה מסיח עמי וכ׳</he> who art thou that art talking to me &c.?—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13:16">Gen. R. s. 13</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>שיח</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 2:5">Gen. II, 5</cite>) <he>כל … כאילו מְשִׂיחִין אלו וכ׳</he> all trees speak to one another as it were; <he>מש׳ עם הבריות</he> speak to men; Yalk. ib. 20.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:15">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>להָשִׂיחַ עלינו</he> to talk against us. Tanḥ. T’rum. 9; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 587">Yalk. Mal. 587</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00084"><he>קָבַע</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—<he>מסיח לפי תומו</he>, v. <cite ref="V00224"><he>תּוֹם</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Yoma 75a:2">Yoma 75ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>ישחנה</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 12:25">Prov. XII, 25</cite>) <he>חד אמר יִשְּׂחֶנָּה מדעתו וחד אמר יְשִׂיחֶנָה לאחרים</he> one says, let him dismiss it (fr. <cite ref="N01302"><he>נָשַׂח</he></cite> = <cite ref="N00923"><he>נָסַח</he></cite>; Ms. M. 2 <he>יַסִּיחֶנָּה</he>) from his mind; the other says, let him speak it out to others; <cite ref="Sotah 42b">Sot. 42ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 950">Yalk. Prov. 950</cite>; v. <cite ref="N00923"><he>נָסַח</he></cite>.
